plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full Tessera documentation site, focusing on the primary onboarding flow, reference navigation, interactive controls, and responsive layout states.
plan.summary: The exploration will proceed in four phases: validating the homepage onboarding and global controls, navigating the deep reference structure and three-column layouts, testing interactive elements like search and version switching, and finally verifying responsive mobile behavior and layout warnings. The run will prioritize the primary user flow from landing to function reference, while deeply validating high-risk areas like the version switcher and search modal.
assumptions: The version switcher and search modal (⌘K) trigger client-side UI changes without full page reloads.
The left-side TOC tree on reference pages is expandable/collapsible via user interaction.
The 'Get started →' button and quick-start cards likely scroll to sections or link to other pages, despite some prescan `href="#"` values.
The dark/light theme toggle applies a global CSS class to the body or html element.
risk_hotspots: Version switcher (select element missing label/aria-label, potential state loss on change)
Search modal (⌘K) interaction and focus trapping
Three-column layout collapse on reference and function detail pages
Small tap targets across navigation and CTAs (especially on mobile)
Dead links for 'Tutorials', 'Download', 'GitHub', 'Architecture', 'Storage', 'Extensions' which all point to '#'

phases.title: Homepage & Onboarding Flow
phases.objective: Validate the primary landing experience, hero section, and quick-start navigation.
key_checks: Click 'Get started →' and verify scroll or navigation behavior
Click 'View reference' to ensure it navigates to reference.html
Click Quick start cards (Install, Connect, Your first query) and verify behavior
Click Documentation section cards (Architecture, SQL Syntax, Functions, Data Types, Storage, Extensions) and verify routing
exit_criteria: All hero and card links have been clicked and their destinations/scroll behaviors verified
Initial layout and content rendering validated on desktop

phases.title: Reference Navigation & Detail Pages
phases.objective: Validate the three-column reference layout, TOC tree interactions, and canonical function page structure.
key_checks: Expand and collapse nodes in the left-side deep TOC tree on reference.html
Navigate from reference.html popular links to function-date-trunc.html
Verify three-column layout integrity and right-side on-this-page outline on function detail pages
Check collapsible version-history panel and error-case callouts on function-date-trunc.html
Validate syntax highlighting and copy buttons on sql-select.html
exit_criteria: Three-column layout renders without overlap on desktop
At least 3 function/detail pages deeply scrolled and validated

phases.title: Global Controls & Interactive States
phases.objective: Test global interactive elements: theme toggle, version switcher, and search.
key_checks: Toggle dark/light theme (🌓 button) and verify persistence across page navigation
Change version using the select dropdown (e.g., switch to v2.3) and check for content/UI updates or errors
Open search modal via ⌘K button, type a query, and verify results display and keyboard navigation
Verify focus management when opening and closing the search modal
exit_criteria: Theme toggle successfully switches themes and persists
Version switcher alters visible state without breaking layout
Search modal opens, accepts input, and closes cleanly

phases.title: Mobile Responsive & Accessibility Checks
phases.objective: Validate mobile viewport behavior, layout collapses, and tap target accessibility.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport and verify hamburger menu or responsive nav behavior
Check three-column layout collapse on reference.html and function-date-trunc.html (ensure TOC is accessible)
Validate tap target sizes for nav links, quick-start cards, and version switcher
Check for horizontal scrolling or overflow issues on mobile
Verify accessibility of the version switcher select element on mobile
exit_criteria: No critical layout overlaps or horizontal scrolling on mobile
Tap target warnings revisited and contextualized for mobile UX

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 9 known HTML pages, with deep interaction on index, reference, and at least 2 function detail pages
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all global controls (theme, version, search), TOC tree interactions, and canonical page elements (collapsible panels, code copy)
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical navigation and layout checks on mobile viewport, focusing on three-column collapse and tap targets

notes: Several links (Tutorials, Download, GitHub, Architecture, Storage, Extensions) point to '#' and may be stubs; verify if they trigger any UI or are dead ends.
The version switcher lacks an accessible label; include this in the UX critique.
Pay special attention to the three-column layout on function pages, as these are canonical examples of the site's core UX pattern.
